messages:
carmen: Nightly eval alert: 12 prompts failing schema validation for the tool-calling outputs from the new quantized candidate (redwood-q4x-2026). Failing tests show JSON parse errors in our postprocess step. Paste of one problematic output below.

eval-bot: [alert] nightly-eval/2026-03-19 03:05 UTC — 12/50 failures (schema_violation) 

ben: Can you paste the raw function call we received? quick look pls.

carmen: Here is verbatim from the model: ```
{"name":"extract_entities","arguments":"{'entities': ['New York','Acme Inc.'], 'confidence': '0.92'}"}
```

alice: Oh — arguments is a string (single quotes inside) instead of a proper JSON object. That will blow up json.loads() downstream. Also confidence is a string not number.

kai: Did this start after we switched to the q4 quant profile? Could be tokenization/decoder beam changes causing the model to emit repr() style rather than JSON.

carmen: Right timing matches: nightly with quant flag on 2026-03-18 23:00 UTC. The host logs show model variant redwood-q4x-2026:deploy-71. No other infra changes.

ben: Short triage plan: 1) add guard in eval harness to try ast.literal_eval on arguments if json.loads fails (temporary). 2) collect 10 failing examples + model logits for analysis. 3) run the same prompts on non-quantized candidate to confirm regression.

alice: Also check schema evolution — did the tool signature change? Our schema requires confidence (float) and entities (list of objects with 'type' field). The sample only has strings in entities.

carmen: Good call — schema diffs show expected entities as array of {"text","type"}. This model produced flat strings. Looks like generation collapsed structured tokens.

kai: I'll repro locally with quantized weights and temperature=0.0 + sampling off. If it reproduces, likely decoder/quant noise. If not, might be a prompt-format sensitivity.

eval-bot: [note] stash id: nightly/178200-2026-03-19/failures/71 (10 examples attached to the ticket).

ben: For immediate mitigation in prod: patch the postprocess to run a relaxed parser and map simple string entities -> {"text": s, "type": "unknown"} so downstream tooling doesn't crash. We'll log high-cardinality warnings.

alice: Also recommend adding a failing-case unit test to the nightly suite that asserts arguments are valid JSON and types match schema. Prevents regressions when we update quant profiles.

carmen: I'll open a ticket with attached examples + model seed + prompt. Assigning to @kai for repro and @ben for eval harness patch. Thanks — will update thread with root-cause once we have logits. :thumbsup:
